top: Poly Haven and ambientCG are both fully CC0 (verified on their own license pages) and directly cover OASIS's HDRI/env-map and gold-foil-metal PBR texture needs, but every downloaded asset must be resized/recompressed before bundling to fit the 2 MB per-asset ceiling.
goal: Free asset sources for our own builds: 3D models, HDRIs/environment maps, PBR textures (gold, metal, foil); e.g. Poly Haven, ambientCG, Kenney, Quaternius, Three.js example assets; license page per source
